<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#24262B"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#181A20"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="lime" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pink" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#A06AF9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="peach" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFDD72"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FF968E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="5" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".25"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="112" r="82" fill="#A06AF9" opacity=".07"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="622" r="100" fill="#97DAA4" opacity=".04"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="25" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="319" y1="19" x2="319" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="323" y1="17" x2="323" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="15" x2="327" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="21" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="21" x2="346" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="356" y="15" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="358" y="17" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="379" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- top navigation -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,70 22,78 30,86" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="78" x2="40" y2="78" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="78" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="78" r="4" fill="#3A3D46"/>
    <circle cx="369" cy="78" r="4" fill="#3A3D46"/>
  </g>

  <!-- logo -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="25" y="108" width="58" height="58" rx="18" fill="url(#lime)"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="132" r="8" fill="#200E32"/>
    <circle cx="65" cy="132" r="8" fill="#200E32"/>
    <rect x="42" y="142" width="28" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#200E32"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="128" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="128" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <text x="25" y="202" font-family="Poppins" font-size="27" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Create your workspace</text>
  <text x="25" y="229" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#BDBDBD">Set up your team hub and make it yours.</text>

  <!-- workspace name -->
  <text x="25" y="268" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Workspace name</text>
  <rect x="22" y="278" width="346" height="52" rx="14" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="35" y="291" width="27" height="27" rx="9" fill="url(#pink)"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="301" r="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="301" r="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="75" y="311" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Northstar Studio</text>
  <polyline points="342,300 347,305 352,300" fill="none" stroke="#BDBDBD" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- team size -->
  <text x="25" y="365" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">How big is your team?</text>
  <text x="25" y="386" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">You can change this anytime.</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="399" width="108" height="48" rx="13" fill="#9ADB7F"/>
    <text x="76" y="429" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Just me</text>
    <rect x="141" y="399" width="108" height="48" rx="13" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="429" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">2–10</text>
    <rect x="260" y="399" width="108" height="48" rx="13" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="314" y="429" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">11+</text>
  </g>

  <!-- invite -->
  <text x="25" y="483" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Invite a teammate</text>
  <text x="25" y="504" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">Add an email now, or send invitations later.</text>
  <rect x="22" y="516" width="346" height="52" rx="14" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="542" r="11" fill="#3A3D46"/>
  <rect x="42" y="538" width="12" height="9" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polyline points="43,539 48,543 53,539" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="72" y="547" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">name@company.com</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="296" y="527" width="58" height="30" rx="10" fill="#3A3D46"/>
    <line x1="311" y1="542" x2="327" y2="542" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="534" x2="319" y2="550" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- color picker -->
  <text x="25" y="614" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Choose a workspace color</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="632" width="38" height="38" rx="12" fill="#9ADB7F" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="37,650 43,656 53,644" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="76" y="632" width="38" height="38" rx="12" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
    <rect x="127" y="632" width="38" height="38" rx="12" fill="#8E96FF"/>
    <rect x="178" y="632" width="38" height="38" rx="12" fill="#FFDD72"/>
    <rect x="229" y="632" width="38" height="38" rx="12" fill="#FF968E"/>
    <rect x="280" y="632" width="38" height="38" rx="12" fill="#B4DDDD"/>
  </g>

  <!-- action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="704" width="108" height="48" rx="15" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="76" y="734" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Skip</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="142" y="704" width="226" height="48" rx="15" fill="#9ADB7F"/>
    <text x="255" y="734" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Next</text>
    <polyline points="316,728 322,733 316,738" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#181A20" opacity=".96"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="774" x2="368" y2="774" stroke="#3A3D46" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="42,792 51,784 60,792 60,803 43,803" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="39,793 51,782 63,793" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="51" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="126" y="786" width="18" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="791" x2="140" y2="791" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="796" x2="137" y2="796" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="135" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Projects</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="232" cy="790" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="232" cy="800" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="232" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Team</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="330" cy="790" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="330" cy="800" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="330" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="155" y="835" width="80" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
